scope: Fixture and theory review only; no registered grid.
findings: Cumulative first-inactive-frontier expansion preserves the lower certificate and finishes after finitely many node activations.
One selected lower-optimal policy gaining value does not imply a strict root gain; every old root-optimal policy must be affected.
The loop is an AO-star/LAO-star/BRTDP adaptation and needs cached incremental AO-OT as its direct baseline.
Ten small configurations verify correctness, but plateaus and repeated sweeps can cost more work than one exact DP.
decision_detail: Do not register H_C02 as a new mechanism. Keep it as an exact search controller/baseline and move the claim to a transport-specific operation that omits local OT solves with a replayable certificate.
not_inferred: No impossibility claim for heuristic search, active sets, tree algorithms or certification.
